description: Subject-domain overlay: what each workspace organ/hangar is. Additive after factory seed + stack OP-PROC. Not the 0.1.8 dump. Groover is not Repertoire.

implementation_guidance.how_to_use: hydrateWritableSignals merges these names into the project dest after stack-overlay. Existing names keep stats. Flesh repo-* from live package.json when the dest definition is still the generic field-observed stub.
implementation_guidance.priority_order: factory traps, then OP-PROC stack, then subject repos. Never write the factory tarball.

signals.evaluation_criteria: Task language about mill, Codex, Station heat, or consumer MCP routes to this name.
signals.validation_experiment: Ask getTaskConfidence about surviving the context window / Cursor hooks.
signals.master_index_integration: Project dest only. Factory tarball stays 8 names.
signals.implementation_notes: Hangar is not suit. Do not deploy this tarball onto website/blips/clearing.
signals.example_inference_snippet: 0xRay suit that survives the context window. Cursor fifth wear. Mill plus inspect.
